title: c2.unit.status
description: What the C2 engine is doing with a unit: task, movement and engagement orders with status, hold, fire authority and filter, override target and stickiness, route, yield/leash, divert, self-defence, advance, VIP threat, weapons control, on-contact. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

unit.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".
